question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘Commence’ from the given sentence.

Let’s put an end to this discussion about voodoo and instead talk about something amusing.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **The word '**commence' **means to bring or come into activity; begin; start.(आरंभ)

 
 
• Example- The festivities will commence with a parade.
 
 
 
• "**End**"- a final part of something; finish; close.(अंत) 
 
 
• ​**Example**- His career was at an end.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of '**commence**' is '**end**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is **end**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meaning and example sentences.

 
• **Voodoo(**जादू टोना)**: **A religion that is based on African ancestor worship and practiced chiefly in Haiti.

 
 
• **Example- **Rahul's family practiced **voodoo**.
 
 
 
• **Discussion(**बहस)**: **The action or process of talking about something in order to reach a decision or to exchange ideas.
 
 
• **Example- **The committee acts as a forum for **discussion**.
 
 
 
• **Amusing(**विनोदी): causing laughter and providing entertainment.
 
 
• ​**Example**- David found the joke very amusing.
